WITH date_months AS (
  SELECT generate_series(1222, 1233) AS d_month_seq
),
branch_a AS (
  SELECT item.i_manager_id, date_dim.d_moy, SUM(store_sales.ss_sales_price) AS sum_sales
  FROM item
  JOIN store_sales ON store_sales.ss_item_sk = item.i_item_sk
  JOIN date_dim ON store_sales.ss_sold_date_sk = date_dim.d_date_sk
  JOIN store ON store_sales.ss_store_sk = store.s_store_sk
  WHERE date_dim.d_month_seq IN (SELECT d_month_seq FROM date_months)
    AND item.i_category IN ('Books','Children','Electronics')
    AND item.i_class IN ('personal','portable','reference','self-help')
    AND item.i_brand IN ('scholaramalgamalg #14','scholaramalgamalg #7','exportiunivamalg #9','scholaramalgamalg #9')
  GROUP BY item.i_manager_id, date_dim.d_moy
),
branch_b AS (
  SELECT item.i_manager_id, date_dim.d_moy, SUM(store_sales.ss_sales_price) AS sum_sales
  FROM item
  JOIN store_sales ON store_sales.ss_item_sk = item.i_item_sk
  JOIN date_dim ON store_sales.ss_sold_date_sk = date_dim.d_date_sk
  JOIN store ON store_sales.ss_store_sk = store.s_store_sk
  WHERE date_dim.d_month_seq IN (SELECT d_month_seq FROM date_months)
    AND item.i_category IN ('Women','Music','Men')
    AND item.i_class IN ('accessories','classical','fragrances','pants')
    AND item.i_brand IN ('amalgimporto #1','edu packscholar #1','exportiimporto #1','importoamalg #1')
  GROUP BY item.i_manager_id, date_dim.d_moy
),
monthly_sales AS (
  SELECT i_manager_id, d_moy, SUM(sum_sales) AS sum_sales
  FROM (
    SELECT i_manager_id, d_moy, sum_sales FROM branch_a
    UNION ALL
    SELECT i_manager_id, d_moy, sum_sales FROM branch_b
  ) AS u
  GROUP BY i_manager_id, d_moy
),
monthly_with_avg AS (
  SELECT i_manager_id, sum_sales,
         AVG(sum_sales) OVER (PARTITION BY i_manager_id) AS avg_monthly_sales
  FROM monthly_sales
)
SELECT i_manager_id, sum_sales, avg_monthly_sales
FROM monthly_with_avg
WHERE CASE WHEN avg_monthly_sales > 0 THEN ABS(sum_sales - avg_monthly_sales) / avg_monthly_sales ELSE NULL END > 0.1
ORDER BY i_manager_id, avg_monthly_sales, sum_sales
LIMIT 100
